query:
SELECT
            bp.id,
            bp.account_id,
            bp.board_id,
            bp.icon,
            get_i18n_string(bp.title, $1) AS title,
            CASE WHEN $2 THEN get_i18n_string(bp.content, $1) END AS content,
            CASE WHEN $3 THEN get_i18n_string(bp.content_html, $1) END AS content_html,
            CASE WHEN $4 THEN get_i18n_string(bp.content_plain, $1) END AS content_plain,
            get_i18n_string(bp.location, $1) AS location,
            bp.event_from,
            bp.event_to,
            bp.created_at,
            ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'status', m.status, 'mime', m.mime, 'size_bytes', m.size_bytes,
                    'content', jsonb_build_object('type', m.type, 'width', m.width, 'height', m.height, 'variants', m.variants, 'filename', m.filename))
                FROM media m WHERE m.post_id = bp.id ORDER BY m.position) AS "media!: Vec<PostMediaModel>",
            CASE WHEN $5 THEN (SELECT array_agg(bpp.board_id) FROM board_pinned_posts bpp
                WHERE bpp.post_id = bp.id
                AND (bpp.pinned_until IS NULL OR bpp.pinned_until >= NOW())) END AS "pinned_on: Vec<i32>"
        FROM board_posts bp
        WHERE TRUE
            -- visibility
            AND (bp.visibility = 'public'
                OR ($6::uuid IS NOT NULL AND (bp.visibility = 'logged_in' OR account_board_perm_exists($6, bp.board_id, 'view'::board_perm))))
            -- search
            AND ($7::text IS NULL
                OR get_i18n_string(bp.title, $1) ILIKE '%' || $7 || '%'
                OR get_i18n_string(bp.location, $1) ILIKE '%' || $7 || '%')
        ORDER BY (bp.event_from <= now() AND bp.event_to >= now()), bp.created_at DESC
        LIMIT $8 OFFSET $9
